# Isovax Technologies

> > Leading manufacturer of pharmaceutical containment solutions including isolators, RABS, and cleanroom equipment for API, OSD, and injectable formulations.

Isovax Technologies specializes in advanced containment systems for pharmaceutical manufacturing, offering VHP-compatible isolators (cRABS, ORABS), biosafety cabinets, and containment accessories like Rapid Transfer Ports (RTP), Split Butterfly Valves, and Alpha/Beta valves for sterility protection and operator safety.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Containment Solutions
- Isolators (API, OSD, Injectable)
- RABS (cRABS, ORABS)
- VHP Sterilization
- Rapid Transfer Port (RTP)
- Split Butterfly Valve
- Alpha Valve & Beta Valve
- Biosafety Cabinets
- Laminar Air Flow
- Cleanroom Equipment
- Barrier Systems
- Oncology Handling
- Sterility Protection
- Particle Containment
- Transfer Ports
